key_findings: Diosmetin relieves spinal nerve ligation-induced mechanical and thermal allodynia and suppresses spinal glial and DRG inflammatory responses.
Diosmetin upregulates Nrf2 and HO-1 while lowering Keap1 and NF-κB p-p65, implicating the Keap1/Nrf2/NF-κB pathway in its analgesic action.
